Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (April 20, 2023) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Ariba Document Number 3865027173, and Contract Number 23TR-OM-SSZ-SAM-TS Description: For the non-exclusive supply and custom application, removal and re-application of screed applied field reacted polymeric (Cold Plastic) and Preformed Thermoplastic pavement markings including but not limited to transverse, centre/lane lines, stop bars, zebra bars, "School" and "40"/"30" symbols, as enhancements to Vision Zero - School Safety Zones within the City of Toronto from date of award to October 31, 2023.
